source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Grab one by one each field of test records.
3. Read the field values and extract the latest value.
4. Match the field name to a standard performance test template template.
5. Use the extracted value to create a performance tests result.
6. Do this will all fields.
7. Do this with all test records. 
8. And When there are all test records processed, create a performance tests report with an aggregated data with a calculated through the aggregated values.

Can you find some design flaws?
